comment: The targets release.yml builds, declared ONCE: the matrix job derives what the rpm and deb builds and the install-and-qualify job read from this (tools/release-matrix.mjs). Drop a target here and its install cell goes with it. Every package in every cell (owner ruling 2026-11-26): rpm fc45 x86_64 and aarch64, deb trixie arm64 and amd64, each built and installed; the 2026-11-19 development matrix (x86_64 rpm, arm64 deb) is gone, and plugin-hostd builds against libplugin-qualification-db-dev on amd64 since plugin-db-qualification 0.1.1. deb lists arm64 first: a pull request's dry run (arm off) builds and installs the first architecture alone, the Zynthian one.
